entry.title: Ritam369/chaiWinder: My own lightweight utility-first CSS engine using JavaScript only. Instead of writing traditional CSS, users will write class names following a pattern like chai-* (for example: chai-p-2, chai-bg-red, chai-text-center). Your script will scan the DOM, read these class names, convert them into corresponding inline styles, and apply them dynamically.
